narration: You arrive without a moment before. Beneath your boots the ground is cool, fine grey dust, soft as ash, stretching out into a dark that has no edges. Far to the north, a single small light flickers, amber and patient, as though someone has just lit it for you.

facts.description: A wide flat plain of fine pale grey dust, soft and slightly rippled, fading into darkness in every direction.
facts.placement: underfoot, extending all around the wanderer

facts.description: A small amber flame in a tiny glass lantern on a thin dark post about 2 m tall, flickering gently and casting a faint warm glow on the dust.
facts.placement: about 35 m north of the wanderer

notes: Spread a wide plain of rippled grey ash underfoot and lit a small amber lantern on a dark post far to the north.

ops.name: ash_plain
ops.doc: Wide flat rippled dust disc at y=0. params: radius (m), color

ops.name: lantern_post
ops.doc: Thin dark post with a glass lantern and flickering amber flame. params: height (m), color

thought: A tiny light far ahead, as if lit for me. I can barely see a thin dark shape on the horizon in the picture. I'll go toward it.
action: walk north across the ash toward the amber light

narration: You walk north, and the ash whispers under your boots, leaving a trail of shallow prints behind you. The lantern grows from a spark to a steady amber flame on its thin black post. Around its base the dust lies in a ring of curious stones, pale and smooth, as though placed there. A faint, cold breeze drifts past you toward the light.
movement: walks about 25 m north across the ash and stops roughly 10 m south of the distant_lantern

facts.description: A ring of about eight smooth, pale grey stones, each roughly knee-high and egg-shaped, set in a circle 4 m across around the lantern post.
facts.placement: centered on distant_lantern, about 10 m north of the wanderer

facts.description: A line of shallow boot prints pressed into the grey ash, trailing back into the dark.
facts.placement: extending from the wanderer 25 m south along the path walked

notes: Set eight pale egg-shaped stones in a 4 m ring around the lantern, and pressed a trail of alternating boot prints 25 m back south. The Wanderer now stands 10 m from the light.

ops.name: stone_ring
ops.doc: Ring of smooth egg-shaped stones. params: count, radius (m), height (m), color

ops.name: footprints
ops.doc: Line of alternating boot prints running south (+Z) from origin. params: length (m), stride (m), color

thought: The lantern is close now, ringed by pale stones. Someone placed them here, and I want to know why.
action: kneel beside the ring of pale stones and examine one closely

narration: You cross the last few meters and kneel at the nearest stone. It is cool and smooth as river glass, and faintly translucent, with a pale blue glow curled deep inside like a held breath. Brushing away the dust, you find a thin line of tiny symbols circling its base, and a hairline crack running up one side. Behind the stones, the lantern's flame leans toward you, as if listening.
movement: walks about 10 m north to the edge of lantern_stone_ring and kneels beside the southernmost stone

facts.description: The southernmost egg-shaped stone is faintly translucent with a soft pale blue glow inside, and a hairline crack running up one side.
facts.placement: southernmost stone of lantern_stone_ring, about 1 m north of the wanderer

facts.description: A thin band of tiny carved spiral and dot symbols circling the base of the glowing stone, filled with darker grey dust.
The amber flame now leans gently south toward the wanderer, though the breeze is faint.
facts.placement: centered in lantern_stone_ring, about 3 m north of the wanderer

notes: Set a translucent, blue-glowing cracked stone over the southernmost egg and circled its base with tiny carved symbols. The lantern flame now leans south toward you, and I moved you to kneel beside the stone.

ops.name: glow_stone
ops.doc: Translucent egg stone with inner blue glow and hairline crack. params: color, glow

ops.name: carved_band
ops.doc: Elliptical band of tiny carved spiral/dot symbols on the ground-level base of a stone. params: rx, rz, count

ops.name: lantern_post
ops.doc: Thin dark post with a glass lantern and flickering amber flame leaning south. params: height, lean

thought: The symbols around the stone's base might tell me why I'm here. The glow inside feels like it's breathing.
action: trace the tiny symbols around the stone's base with my finger and whisper them aloud

narration: You trace the spirals with one fingertip, whispering each shape as your finger finds it. At the last dot the blue glow brightens, and the hairline crack widens with a soft chime like struck glass. A thin ribbon of pale light spills out and runs across the ash to the east, pointing to something not yet there.

facts.description: The cracked stone now glows brighter blue, and the crack has widened to a finger's width, leaking light.
facts.placement: southernmost stone of lantern_stone_ring, about 1 m north of the wanderer

facts.description: A thin, flat ribbon of pale blue light about 10 cm wide, lying on the ash like a glowing line, faintly pulsing.
facts.placement: starts at stone_inner_glow and runs about 20 m east across the ash_ground

notes: The cracked stone now burns brighter with a wider crack, and a thin pulsing ribbon of blue light runs 20 m east across the ash.

ops.name: glow_stone
ops.doc: Translucent egg stone with inner blue glow and crack. params: color, glow, boost (brightness multiplier), crack (width m)
